verdict.rationale: jo documents its own always-on cloud machine that keeps working when you are away. It can work overnight, reading what came in and preparing your morning, and you can give it a job plus a schedule so it delivers plans and task reviews without being asked each time. It can also take on multi-step work such as building and publishing a website and keeping it current. Missing for 10: an explicit ad-hoc delegation flow for arbitrary multi-step tasks with progress tracking, a documented review/approval step before results are finalized, and independent or hands-on corroboration of background task execution.
